highlights.title: Problem solving
highlights.desc: I start with the problem, not the framework. I break requirements into small, testable pieces, find the simplest thing that works, and iterate from real feedback.

highlights.title: Full-stack coding
highlights.desc: From Ruby on Rails APIs to React front ends, I write clean, readable code that teammates and clients can maintain long after launch.

highlights.title: Cloud & shipping
highlights.desc: I build serverless apps on AWS and automate deploys to S3 and CloudFront, so shipping a change is a single command, not a ceremony.
